meta.project: AWT Inventory Tracker API - Master Data & Code Rules

product_overview: Backend API endpoints to support item and vendor master-data rules for the AWT Inventory Tracker: case-insensitive code normalization/uniqueness, vendor next-code suggestion, and safe vendor deletion with admin protection.
core_goals: Ensure item and vendor codes are treated case-insensitively and normalized to uppercase to prevent duplicate master-data records.
Provide a predictable next-sequence vendor code suggestion based on a prefix and existing numeric suffixes.
Protect data integrity by preventing hard-deletes of vendors that are referenced by transactions or linked to items, and restrict deletion to admins.
Expose clear API responses for integration with the frontend (happy paths and explicit error conditions).
Require authentication for all master-data endpoints and enforce admin-only actions where appropriate.

features.name: Item Code Uniqueness Check
features.description: Case-insensitive check that tells whether an item code already exists. Input is normalized to uppercase and the API returns existence and item id when found.
user_flows: GET /api/items/check-code?code=abc-001 with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 { exists: false, id: null }
GET /api/items/check-code?code=ABC-001 with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 { exists: true, id: 123 }
GET /api/items/check-code (no code query) with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 400 { error: 'code query parameter is required' }

features.name: Vendor Next Code Suggestion
features.description: Suggests the next sequential vendor code for a given prefix by finding the maximum numeric suffix among existing vendor codes with that prefix, incrementing it by 1 and padding to three digits.
user_flows: GET /api/vendors/next-code?prefix=DEX with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 { nextCode: 'DEX005' }
GET /api/vendors/next-code?prefix=ACME with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 { nextCode: 'ACME001' }
GET /api/vendors/next-code (no prefix) with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 400 { error: 'prefix query parameter is required' }

features.name: Vendor Code Uniqueness Check
features.description: Case-insensitive check to determine whether a vendor code already exists. Input is normalized to uppercase and the API returns existence and vendor id when applicable.
user_flows: GET /api/vendors/check-code?code=dex with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 { exists: true, id: 42 }
GET /api/vendors/check-code?code=NEWVENDOR with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 { exists: false, id: null }
GET /api/vendors/check-code (no code) with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 400 { error: 'code query parameter is required' }

features.name: Vendor Hard Delete
features.description: Permanently deletes a vendor only if it has no references (no transactions, not a default vendor on any item, and not an additional vendor on any item). Action requires admin privileges; deletion is blocked with clear errors when references exist.
user_flows: DELETE /api/vendors/123 with Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_JWT> -> Receive 200 { message: 'Vendor deleted' }
DELETE /api/vendors/123 with Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_JWT> (vendor has references) -> Receive 400 { error: 'vendor has references' }
DELETE /api/vendors/999 with Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_JWT> (vendor not found) -> Receive 404 { error: 'Vendor not found' }
DELETE /api/vendors/123 with Authorization: Bearer <USER_JWT> (non-admin) -> Receive 403 { error: 'Admin access required' }

features.name: Item Code Case-Insensitive Create Protection
features.description: When creating items, the API normalizes itemCode to uppercase and enforces case-insensitive uniqueness; duplicate codes (regardless of case) are rejected with a 409 Conflict.
user_flows: POST /api/items with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { itemCode: 'abc-001', description: 'Brake pad', unitOfMeasure: 'EA' } -> Receive 201 { item: { id: 10, itemCode: 'ABC-001', description: 'Brake pad', unitOfMeasure: 'EA' } }

POST /api/items with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { itemCode: 'AbC-001', description: 'Duplicate attempt' } (code already exists as 'ABC-001') -> Receive 409 { error: 'Item code "ABC-001" already exists' }
POST /api/items with no Authorization header -> Receive 401 { error: 'Unauthorized' }

features.name: Vendor Code Case-Insensitive Create Protection
features.description: When creating vendors, the API normalizes vendorCode to uppercase and enforces case-insensitive uniqueness; attempts to create a vendor with a code that differs only in case are rejected with 409 Conflict.
user_flows: POST /api/vendors with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { vendorCode: 'dex-1', vendorName: 'Dexter' } -> Receive 201 { vendor: { id: 5, vendorCode: 'DEX-1', vendorName: 'Dexter' } }

POST /api/vendors with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body { vendorCode: 'DEX-1', vendorName: 'Duplicate' } (code already exists as 'DEX-1') -> Receive 409 { error: 'Vendor code "DEX-1" already exists' }
POST /api/vendors with no Authorization header -> Receive 401 { error: 'Unauthorized' }
